summary: Taoping Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on September 3, 2026, disclosing a change in its certifying accountant. On August 31, 2026, the audit committee dismissed PKF Littlejohn LLP and engaged Li CPA LLC as its new independent auditor for fiscal year 2026. PKF's reports for 2024-2025 contained going-concern explanatory paragraphs, and management identified internal control deficiencies. No disagreements occurred. This is a routine auditor-change disclosure, not a special situation.
